notes: §1985:VII.4.2.4 GR3 (Amendment 2 applied): "The results of executing each type of CLOSE for each category of file are summarized in table 1". Every sequential file is placed in the Non-Reel/Unit column (SequentialConnector.Category; docs/CONFORMANCE.md DOC-A.1-24: a host path with no reel, unit or volume behind it), whose cells are C; C,E; C,H; F; F. BindClose keeps the written form, Table14.Cell gives the cell and FileRegistry.CloseCell executes it: C runs the closing operations; F is "Execution of this statement is considered successful. The file remains in the open mode, the file position indicator is unchanged, and no action takes place except as specified in general rule 4" with I-O status 07 (§1985:VII.1.3.5: "the referenced file is on a non-reel/unit medium"); H closes "as if none of the optional phrases is present", also 07. The 1985 arm is WITH LOCK, which VisitCloseOption admits through 2014 (COBOL0902 from 2023): CloseWithLock closes and, on a successful close only, records E ("The file is locked and cannot be opened again during this execution of this run unit"), and SharedOpenAttempt answers every later OPEN with 38; the lock set is cleared only when the run unit is reset. Probed at --std 85 for output, input, input-output and an absent OPTIONAL input file: UNIT, REEL and FOR REMOVAL leave the file open at its position with 07, NO REWIND closes with 07, a LOCK of a file not open is 42 and locks nothing, and OPEN INPUT, OUTPUT and EXTEND after LOCK are 38. Two things this verdict takes as given: the placement itself is GR2's (the 1985 preface calls a sequential mass storage file "logically equivalent to the treatment of a file on tape"; the reel/unit columns are unreachable under the documented placement, and CCVS-85 SQ124A expects 07 and an open file for CLOSE UNIT on the same footing), and symbol C's label processing is by "the implementor's standard label convention", of which WiseOwl has none (no label is written or read; see 1985-GR-VII.3.9.4-1). The witness runs CLOSE UNIT, REEL FOR REMOVAL and WITH NO REWIND on an output file (three records written through them), then CLOSE WITH LOCK (00) and the refused re-OPEN (USE procedure, 38).
